BEM-VINDO AO MUNDO PSICODÉLICO FESTIVAL: @silverpandamusic 🔥

Meio brasileiro e meio israelense, o duo Silver Panda é formado por Leo Barcellos e Shlomi Berg.

👉 O duo já chegou a alcançar o nº 1 overall do Beatport, consolidando-se como um dos maiores projetos de techno melódico do planeta. Também lançaram pela Tomorrowland Music a track “Unity” em collab com Like Mike e Against All Ødds.

Além de sua atuação no duo, um dos integrantes da dupla, Shlomi Berg é amplamente reconhecido na cena global de psy trance sob o nome artístico BERG, um dos maiores nomes do gênero no mundo.

caption:
Silver Panda’s groundbreaking sound has propelled them into Beatport’s Top 10 Melodic Techno Artists.

In a remarkably short period, they have garnered support from some of the industry’s leading figures and collaborated with renowned artists such as John Summit, Space Motion, and Sevenn. Their most recent remix of “Sweet Disposition” with John Summit has been played on the dance floor of some of the world’s most renowned clubs, secured them the #1 spot on Beatport’s Overall Chart, and has accumulated over 50M streams across platforms since its release earlier this year. 

Demonstrating their unique blend of creativity, collaboration, and entrepreneurship, Silver Panda launched Panda Lad Records. Within just 12 months, the label has ascended to Beatport’s #1 Melodic Techno label.

With a list of remarkable accomplishments under their belt, The Bullitt Agency is excited to announce that Silver Panda has joined our roster for North, Central, and South American representation.
